card.name: Small words before antibody or protein terms
card.fires_on: Small linking words or punctuation (e.g., 'e.g.,', 'of', 'in', 'is a') just before the text names antibodies, biologics or proteins, mostly in biologic drug labels and lyophilization articles.

card.plain: It fires on small linking words when the next word is likely to be an antibody or biologic term.
